title: Accounts and permissions
symptom: Cannot sign in, Forbidden, or missing menus
remedy: Check the username, account status, assigned role and subscription. Use the Company Admin account for administration; guard accounts belong in the APK.
manual: Sign in with each test role. Viewer must not create records; guard must not read admin records; company records must stay isolated.

title: Company, sites and staffing
symptom: Missing employees or assignment choices
remedy: Create the person, employee and user in that order. Check active site, guard position, authority level and employee assignment.
manual: Create a test person and employee; assign an active position at the correct site and verify selectors.

title: Shifts and attendance
symptom: Empty shifts, clock-in refused, incorrect times
remedy: Check employee assignment, shift start/end and device timezone. Refresh the APK after assignment.
manual: Assign a current test shift, clock in once, verify duplicate handling and clock out.

title: Patrols, schedules and checkpoints
symptom: Patrol will not start, missing scans or missed patrols
remedy: Check active route, site, guard assignment and start window. QR text and NFC UID must exactly match the checkpoint. Check server time and the supervisor attention page.
manual: Start a scheduled patrol, scan every checkpoint, finish it; separately let a test window expire and inspect missed and incomplete history.

title: Android and offline sync
symptom: Cannot reach server, pending queue, duplicate actions
remedy: Use the same local network and current APK. Confirm the PC server is running. Keep pending actions; do not clear app data or reinstall until the queue is reconciled.
manual: Queue an action offline, reconnect and sync twice. Verify a single server record and visible rejection of invalid actions.

title: Device custody and sessions
symptom: Device unavailable or session cannot start
remedy: Check device status, current custody and active session. Close an existing session through the authorised workflow before reassigning.
manual: Assign a test device, open and close a session, return it and inspect the audit record.

title: Incidents and Occurrence Book
symptom: Save fails, wrong status or missing history
remedy: Check required fields, site and role. Resolve validation messages; refresh before retrying a conflict. Preserve original entries and use the revision workflow.
manual: Create and update test records; verify timestamps, lifecycle restrictions, revisions and audit entries.

title: Visitors, vehicles and access
symptom: Entry denied, missing visit or departure
remedy: Check visitor status, host, site and active visit. Confirm registration and access authorisation.
manual: Register a visitor and vehicle, record authorised entry and departure, then verify history.

title: Inspections
symptom: Checklist or completion fails
remedy: Check inspector assignment, required checklist outcomes and corrective actions.
manual: Create a test inspection, record findings and required actions, complete it and inspect history.

title: Alerts and notifications
symptom: Notification not delivered or alert unresolved
remedy: Check in-app records separately from external delivery. Confirm provider configuration, recipient settings and delivery status with an authorised administrator. Never paste provider secrets here.
manual: Create a test alert, acknowledge/resolve it; test each configured external channel with an approved recipient.

title: Reports and dashboard
symptom: Empty report, incorrect totals or missing activity
remedy: Check date range, company, timezone and filters. Compare with source records; empty data does not prove a service failure.
manual: Create a known test record, verify its report and dashboard counts and audit entry without exposing another company.

title: Plans and limits
symptom: Feature unavailable or account limit reached
remedy: Check the company plan, trial expiry and status. Permission and subscription are separate requirements. Do not grant broad roles to bypass an expired plan.
manual: Verify the appropriate plan allows intended features and rejects excluded actions.

title: GPS and geofences
symptom: Position outside boundary or location unavailable
remedy: Check device permission, GPS accuracy, latitude/longitude order and radius in metres. Use Geofences > Check point. Background tracking and automatic boundary entry/exit alerts are not implemented.
manual: Test known inside/outside points, then compare a real outdoor device position. Do not treat this as a continuous tracking test.

title: Contracts and posts
symptom: Post or contract missing from a selector
remedy: Check site, contract dates and active status; confirm company membership.
manual: Create test contract and post records and verify references and date validation.

title: Help and local AI writing
symptom: Slow writing response or inaccurate advice
remedy: Navigation help uses verified guidance. For writing, check the local model service and configuration; a timeout should give a fallback. Never submit personal data.
manual: Ask a navigation question, then a fictional writing question; verify no customer records or actions are accessible.

title: Website and sessions
symptom: Menu stuck, blank screen, stale styling or expired login
remedy: Refresh the page after saving work. Check browser connectivity. Sign in again after expiry; do not repeatedly retry a permission denial.
manual: Check mobile menu open/close, keyboard navigation, form errors, session warning and sign-out.

title: Server, backup and recovery
symptom: Site offline, disk full or restore needed
remedy: Check web/database services, disk space and restricted server logs. Back up before repair. Restore only to an isolated database first. Never expose this local console to the internet.
manual: Run a scheduled backup and a verified isolated restore. Test service restart, TLS and monitoring separately before public launch.

title: APK installation and phone hardware
symptom: Install warning, QR/NFC/GPS failure
remedy: Use the supplied signed build from a trusted source; debug builds are for testing. Record the exact Android warning. Do not disable Play Protect. Confirm camera/location permissions and NFC hardware.
manual: On a physical phone test login, camera scan, NFC tag, outdoor GPS, loss of connection and app restart.

title: MFA and login sessions
symptom: Authenticator code rejected or session revoked
remedy: Use a fresh code, check phone time, or use one single-use recovery code. Review Account security; support and device-policy management require an MFA-authenticated session.
manual: Enable MFA on a disposable account. Reject replayed codes; revoke one session and verify another stays active.

title: Managed Android and kiosk recovery
symptom: Apps or notification shade not restricted
remedy: Confirm company-owned device-owner provisioning and enrollment. Compare saved and reported revisions. APPLIED is a device report, not attestation. Use the securely stored per-device recovery code offline if needed.
manual: Test a managed physical phone, an ordinary unmanaged phone, approved/unapproved apps, notification shade, reboot, offline recovery and remote release.

title: Compliance reminders
symptom: Expired requirement or missing verification
remedy: Review evidence, correct the renewal date and record manual verification. Check escalation-worker health. This does not automatically verify PSiRA registration.
manual: Create a due requirement, verify it, renew it and confirm verification resets for a new evidence review.

title: Equipment issue and return
symptom: Equipment already issued or custody disputed
remedy: Review open handovers and physical custody before returning an item. Record condition accurately; do not create a second issue to bypass an open handover.
manual: Issue and return a test radio; reject double issue and double return; verify company isolation.

title: Approved client reports
symptom: Client cannot see a published report
remedy: Check the same-company user/client mapping, client_portal.read permission and the site client ID. Publish only reviewed client-appropriate content.
manual: Map two separate client accounts and verify neither can read the other client reports or internal incident records.

title: Approved attendance export
symptom: Attendance absent from payroll export
remedy: Complete and review attendance, approve it, then use the correct date range. Corrections invalidate earlier approvals. Exported hours do not calculate wages or overtime.
manual: Approve attendance, export hours, change a timestamp and verify the stale approval is excluded until reviewed again.

title: Automatic in-app escalation
symptom: No attention notification or backup escalation
remedy: Check active rules, recipient accounts, worker schedule and worker exit status. Delivery is in-app only; no SMS, email or WhatsApp provider is connected.
manual: Trigger a missed shift or due compliance item; run the worker twice and verify one event, acknowledgement and backup escalation behaviour.

title: Mobile reports, photos and diagnostic snapshots
symptom: Queued report blocked or phone diagnostics stale
remedy: Keep the encrypted queue. Review the HTTP status and supervisor reference, fix the account/site problem, then retry unchanged. Uploaded diagnostics show last receipt time; offline records cannot be pulled remotely.
manual: Queue a report/photo offline, retry after interrupted delivery and verify exactly one record; reject invalid images and wrong-company shifts.
